infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Drift-O-Meter reads the gyroscope and accelerometer to measure how far the car is sliding.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Drift-O-Meter uses GPS speed and direction of travel to judge your drifts and map the track.
